title: Praying in congregation (jama‘ah)
intro: Salah prayed together in jama‘ah is worth 25 or 27 times more.

learn.html: We learned that Allah, the Most High, has strictly commanded Muslims to perform the fard prayers. Fard prayers can be prayed alone or in jama‘ah (congregation).

Our Prophet Muhammad (SAW) regularly prayed in jama‘ah, and so showed his followers that praying in jama‘ah is his sunnah. That is why a prayer in jama‘ah is worth 25 or 27 times more than a prayer alone.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember – the niyyah
learn.html: When we pray in jama‘ah, after the words “…qiblati” in the niyyah we add: “iqtadaytu bihaadhal-imaami”, which means “I follow this imam”.

items: the fard of the five daily prayers
witr and tarawih – only in the month of Ramadan
Jumu‘ah, Eid and janazah prayers are prayed only in jama‘ah
some nafl prayers too, like the night prayer (qiyam al-layl), the prayer for rain and the prayer at an eclipse of the sun

learn.text: A jama‘ah needs at least two people

items.label: Imam – the man who leads the jama‘ah and stands in front
Muqtadi – the one who prays behind the imam, standing behind him to his right

items: If there are several muqtadis, they stand in rows (saff).
In the fard, the imam’s recitation counts for the muqtadis too – in qiyam they recite nothing, except Subhanaka in the first rak‘ah.
Muqtadis may not do any part of the Salah before the imam – they must follow him.

practice.title: Match the word and its meaning
pairs: Leads the prayer, stands in front

practice.title: Only in jama‘ah?
practice.prompt: Is this prayer prayed only in jama‘ah, or can it also be prayed alone?

questions.q: How much more is a prayer in jama‘ah worth?
What do we add to the niyyah in jama‘ah?
options: Iqtadaytu bihaadhal-imaami – I follow this imam

questions.q: How many people are needed for a jama‘ah?

options: Behind the imam, to his right

questions.q: What does the muqtadi recite in qiyam of the fard?
options: Only Subhanaka in the first rak‘ah

questions.q: May a muqtadi go into ruku‘ before the imam?
options: No – he must follow the imam

practice.title: Do your homework
prompts: 📦 Make two boxes: “I PRAYED IN THE MASJID” and “I PRAYED AT HOME”.
✂️ Each time you pray in the masjid, put 27 paper slips in the first box; each time you pray at home, put 1 slip in the second.
🤔 After seven days, count them: which is worth more – a prayer in the masjid or at home – and why?
